title: Baqaei recalls Minab school martyrs on first day of new school year

title: Iran president at UNGA: ‘We do not fear war to defend ourselves’

title: بزشكيان: إيران لن تستسلم بالقوة العسكرية
body: حذر الرئيس الإيراني مسعود بزشكيان، في كلمة أمام الجمعية العامة للأمم المتحدة، من توسيع نطاق الحرب في المنطقة، معتبرا أن ذلك "لن يحقق الأمن"، وأن السلام في إيران "لن يأتي من ساحة المعركة"، مشيرا إلى أن إيران لن تستسلم بالقوة العسكرية لكنها تؤمن بالدبلوماسية.

title: فيديو صندوق اقتراع في طنجة يثير الجدل.. القضاء يتحرك
body: أعلن الوكيل العام للملك لدى محكمة الاستئناف في طنجة، شمال المغرب، عن فتح بحث قضائي بخصوص ما تم تداوله بشأن ظهور صندوق زجاجي بداخله بعض الأغلفة البيضاء.

title: وسط الحرب.. "مدرب الطوارئ" يقود اليمن في خليجي 27
body: بينما تتجه أنظار جماهير كرة القدم الخليجية إلى الملاعب والنتائج في "خليجي 27"، يدخل منتخب اليمن البطولة محملا بما يتجاوز حسابات الفوز والخسارة.

title: MP: No meeting between Pezeshkian and Trump
body: TEHRAN — Esmaeil Kowsari, a member of the Iranian Parliament’s National Security and Foreign Policy Committee, has described US President Donald Trump’s remarks against Iran at the UN General Assembly as “political bluffing and psychological warfare,” saying there will be no meeting between Trump and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian.

title: 64 street plays spotlight Sacred Defense themes across Iran
body: TEHRAN- A total of 64 street theater productions from 26 Iranian provinces are being staged across the country as part of the “Narration of Epic” program, which is being held alongside Sacred Defense Week to commemorate the experiences and sacrifices of the 1980-1988 Iran-Iraq war through the language of theater.

title: Iranian animation “A Faraway Place” wins at Russian film festival
body: TEHRAN- Iranian short animation “A Faraway Place” has won second place in the over-6 category at the 16th International Youth Film Festival “Light to the World” in Russia.

title: Four Persian books included in White Ravens Catalogue 2026
body: TEHRAN – The White Ravens Catalogue, compiled by Munich’s International Youth Library, has unveiled its 2026 edition with over 200 children's and youth titles in about 40 languages, including four Persian works by authors from Iran.

title: Trump trapped in a conflict with Iran
body: Farhikhtegan analyzed Trump’s speech at the UN. According to the paper, Trump’s speech revolved around one central theme: explaining why he has failed against Iran. The US President, who knows he is highly likely to lose the midterm elections, claimed the elections do not matter to him.

title: IRGC Ground Force chief: Iran will not yield an inch to the enemy
body: TEHRAN — The commander of the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Ground Force, Brigadier General Mohammad Karami, has underscored the Islamic Republic’s unwavering resolve in the face of hostile threats, affirming that Iran will never give in to the enemy.

title: Leader’s advisor: Iran fully prepared for defense; US aggression will bring heavy casualties
body: TEHRAN – A senior military advisor to Leader of the Islamic Revolution Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, says Iran’s armed forces are fully prepared to defend the country in every field, warning the United States would face heavy casualties in the event of any aggression.

title: Trump meets Arab leaders on sidelines of UN General Assembly
body: TEHRAN – US President Donald Trump convened a closed-door meeting with leaders of Arab and Muslim states on Tuesday on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, as uncertainty continues to loom over the nearly seven-month-long war against Iran.

title: Major General Mohsen Rezaei: Trump’s UN Speech constitutes ‘defense of a defeated criminal’
body: TEHRAN – Iranian officials have unleashed a blistering response to US President Donald Trump’s address at the 81st UN General Assembly, dismissing his threats of “annihilation” against the Islamic Republic as the desperate rhetoric of a “defeated criminal” struggling with his own political irrelevance.

title: ‘We will never bow our head’
body: TEHRAN — President Masoud Pezeshkian delivered a powerful address at the 81st session of the UN General Assembly in New York on Wednesday, vehemently condemning US and Israeli aggression, exposing international double standards, and asserting that the Iranian nation will never yield to the language of force.

title: Iranian president addresses UN General Assembly
body: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian addressed the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly on Wednesday, September 23, outlining Iran’s positions on the war with the United States, regional tensions, diplomacy and the country’s peaceful nuclear program.

title: Iran sets conditions for resuming diplomacy with US in Qatar-mediated NY meeting
body: TEHRAN — Iran has laid out its conditions for resuming diplomatic engagement with the United States during a meeting between Iranian and American representatives in New York that was held through Qatari mediation, Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei said.

title: Minab school year begins at site honoring students killed in US-Israeli attack
body: The new academic year officially began in Minab on Wednesday, September 23, with students, families and officials attending a ceremony at the Shajareh Tayyebeh school.

title: Araghchi holds extensive diplomatic talks on UNGA sidelines
body: TEHRAN- Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi called on the international community to hold the United States accountable for its violations of international law and war crimes against Iran, warning that indifference to genocide will have far-reaching consequences for all countries.

title: Israel’s climate crimes
body: TEHRAN - Israel’s environmental damage in Palestine has accompanied the destruction of Palestinian lives, homes and livelihoods. Farmlands and olive groves have been burned or destroyed, while homes, vehicles, cities and refugee camps have been repeatedly bombarded.

title: The empty chairs of Minab
body: MASHHAD — The courtyard was full before the first bell rang. Thousands of children in freshly pressed uniforms stood under a sky that felt too ordinary for the day. They hadn't gathered to start a new school year.

title: ICC refuses to withdraw arrest warrant against Netanyahu
body: The International Criminal Court (ICC) has taken no steps to withdraw arrest warrants or related applications concerning Israeli officials, despite mounting pressure and sanctions from the United States, Deputy Prosecutor Nazhat Shameem Khan has said.

title: ‘School reopening ceremony’ added to Iran’s national intangible heritage list
body: TEHRAN - Iran has officially registered the traditional ceremony marking the reopening of schools as part of the country’s national intangible cultural heritage, the minister of cultural heritage, tourism and handicrafts said on Wednesday.

title: 30 Sasanian silver coins restored in Isfahan workshop
body: TEHRAN - Thirty silver coins dating to the Sasanian period have undergone specialized conservation and restoration at the restoration workshop of the Cultural Heritage Department in Iran’s central Isfahan province, the provincial heritage chief has said.

title: לפני שחותמים: המדריך המשפטי לזוג צעיר שרוכש דירה ראשונה
body: עו"ד מאי צבי, שותפה ומייסדת במשרד עורכי הדין אלי צבי אטיאס ומובילת תחום המקרקעין והנדל"ן, על הטעויות הנפוצות, המלכודות הנסתרות וההגנות שאסור לוותר עליהן בעסקה הגדולה של החיים
